# Roleflow

> Roleflow is an AI Client Acquisition Engine. It answers every inbound DM in seconds, sends voice notes in your own voice (cloned from a short recording), runs follow-ups only within 24 hours, and books qualified leads onto the sales calendar. Roleflow builds and runs the system.

Roleflow (en español: motor de adquisición de clientes con IA) is built for high-ticket coaches, consultants, course creators and agency owners whose personal brand drives sales on Instagram.

Who it fits: businesses with 20+ Instagram DMs a day, an offer above $1,000, a close rate above 20%, and $30k+/month cash collected.
Who it does not fit: businesses selling mainly through WhatsApp, email or phone (Instagram DMs only), low-ticket offers, or very low DM volume.
